text:
emma-support: Customer hit us with repeated high tail latency; they see requests routed to EU despite setting region=us-west in their SDK. attaching their repro curl and a sample req-id from the customer.

emma-support: repro curl:
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx\" \
  -H \"X-Client-Region: \" \
  -H \"X-Client-Region: us-west\" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-neo","input":"hi"}'
```

emma-support: note: they have two X-Client-Region headers (one empty, one correct) — coming from a proxy + our SDK. customer req-id: r-20260317-9a1b2c

oliver-support: can you paste the edge logs / router decision for that req-id? also which SDK version?

emma-support: SDK v2.3.1, edge log excerpt below (redacted):
```
[router] req=r-20260317-9a1b2c headers=[X-Client-Region=, X-Client-Region=us-west] selected_edge=eu-1 reason=region-fallback
[proxy] upstream=nearest-pop fallback_to=eu-1
```

raj-eng: hmm. router is treating the first header token as authoritative even when empty. code path: parseHeaders -> pickFirstNonNullHeaderValue but it's returning empty string and then fallthrough logic sends to default region (eu-1) which is wrong.

lina-plat: interesting — other customers had similar symptoms but usually it was trailing comma or whitespace. this one is literally a duplicated header where the first value is an empty string. Could be proxy injecting an empty header before SDK header.

mike-runtime: quick repro on staging: send two X-Client-Region headers, first blank, second us-west. router selects blank and then policy eval treats blank as missing -> route to primary (eu) due to config. Confirmed.

katie-sre: risk note: changing header precedence could affect other customers who rely on older proxies. we should scope fix: prefer first non-empty trimmed value across repeated header instances. that keeps behaviour stable but avoids empty wins.

raj-eng: agree. patch idea: in header parsing util, iterate header values and pick first value where trim(value) != ''. fallback to explicit default only if all are blank. I can PR.

lina-plat: also add a validation warning in router logs when duplicate region headers are present so we can surface to support automatically.

deploy-bot: rollout scheduled: canary to 10% edge pods at 2026-03-17T15:30Z, full rollout 2026-03-17T16:00Z if no regressions. CI: green.

emma-support: next steps for support: (1) escalate customer and explain we found a router-edge bug triggered by duplicate-empty headers, (2) provide temporary workaround: strip duplicate X-Client-Region from proxy or ensure proxy doesn't add empty header, (3) we'll notify when patch is live (canary at 15:30 UTC).

oliver-support: assigning follow-up to @emma-support + @raj-eng. I'll DM customer with temp mitigation and ETA. :thumbsup:

mike-runtime: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/router/pulls/4823 — tests + log warning included.

katie-sre: postmortem? If canary is clean, we'll include a small blameless note in weekly incidents, not full postmortem.

emma-support: thanks — keeping thread updated with canary health and customer reply.
